text:
jia: quick sanity check for onboarding lilypad-9b-v2 — planning perf sweep + smoke serve tests. two quick asks: 1) exact weights location (sharded vs single file) and any lazy/shard loader quirks, 2) tokenizer oddness: we saw extra <nl> tokens when using sample prompts, any normalization flags? also validating serve config (kv_cache, max_gpu_mem). can someone run a quick latency + throughput sweep for seq=512 bs=[1,4,8] and drop results to the s3 path below?

sam: weights are in gs://redwood-models/lilypad-9b/v2/ — they shipped as 4 shards (shard_00..03.bin). note: the loader uses lazy mmap by default which can cause a small initial stall on first access. run `rwd-model ls gs://redwood-models/lilypad-9b/v2/` to confirm all 4 shards. if you see shard_03 missing it's a sync problem from the packaging job.

bench-bot: scheduled smoke bench job 2865409955 for cluster g4dn-perf-3 (ETA ~15m) :rocket:

lee: tokenizer heads-up — the SPiece vocab has a fused newline token (token id 50265) that our tokenizer normalizer sometimes emits twice when the input contains CRLF. try `--tokenizer-normalize newlines` (new flag in tokenizer v1.8+) or pre-run `tr '\r' '\n'` on test payloads. quick inspect: 
```
# dump tokens for sample
rwd-tokenize --model gs://redwood-models/lilypad-9b/v2/tokenizer.model "Hello\r\nWorld" --ids
```
should show a single 50265; if you see two, normalize.

maria: for perf config: start with kv_cache=false to avoid warmup noise for the first sweep, add `--max-gpu-mem 28G` to be safe on the perf boxes. suggested commands: 
```
rwd-bench run --model gs://redwood-models/lilypad-9b/v2 --seq 512 --batch 1,4,8 --warmup 20 --iters 200 --kv-cache false --profile p99,throughput --out s3://redwood-bench-results/lilypad/v2/
```
and a minimal latency check:
```
rwd-bench run --model gs://redwood-models/lilypad-9b/v2 --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 500 --latency --out s3://redwood-bench-results/lilypad/v2/latency/
```
please include the raw perf JSON + a short note if you had to tweak `--max-gpu-mem`.

jia: thanks — can we also validate `serve.yaml` quick? current draft has `kv_cache: true` and `max_gpu_mem: 0` (auto). maria suggests toggling to false for initial smoke. i'll add a PR to the catalog to toggle if bench indicates better parity.

sam: happy to run tonight on g4dn-perf-3. i'll run both kv_cache=false and kv_cache=true to show delta. i'll post p50/p95/p99 + throughput per-shard. payload: use the shared prompt set `s3://redwood-evalsets/lilypad/mini-smoke.jsonl` unless you want different.

lee: if you hit OOM or CUDA alloc errors, ping @eng-oncall and capture the `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi` output. also consider adding `--max-batch-tokens 4096` as a safety cap. :eyes:

ops-bot: created tracking issue INF-9423 for lilypad-9b onboarding and perf sweep. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-9423

maria: great — i'll watch the s3 folder and start the catalog PR draft once we have bench numbers. if anyone hits the shard sync problem, ping me and i'll re-run the packaging job. thanks :thumbsup:
